PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 13+ years of BFSI experience specialising in trade surveillance, 
corporate actions, fixed income, derivatives, and regulatory compliance across Tier-1 investment banks (HSBC, 
UBS, BNY Mellon). Proven track record in reducing manual processing time, improving data quality, and 
delivering large-scale surveillance model rollouts end-to-end. Proficient in Agile/Scrum, SAFe, SQL, XML/JSON 
data transformation, Dremio, Cucumber BDD, and ELK Stack monitoring. Skilled at bridging business 
stakeholders and technology teams to deliver measurable, compliance-aligned outcomes under MiFID II, MAR, 
and EMIR frameworks.

strengthening cross-border operational knowledge for the Swiss booking centre.
